seo_title: Wedding Videographers in Derbyshire | Zen Visuals, Belper
seo_description: Wedding films by Zuzia and Ben, based in Belper. Whole-day coverage for £1,100, a 3–6 minute film within 3–6 weeks. Check your date.
hero_alt: Bride and groom walking hand in hand across a lawn above the valley
intro: We're Zuzia and Ben, a husband-and-wife team based in Belper. We film weddings across Derbyshire and the rest of the UK, and we stay for the whole day, from getting ready to the last song on the dance floor.

Your wedding film is a 3–6 minute story of your day. We edit the colour to match the light as it changes from morning to evening, and build the sound around your vows, your speeches and the little moments in between.

sections.heading: One price for the whole day
sections.text: Wedding film coverage is £1,100 for your whole day. There are no hourly packages and no watching the clock: we stay for as long as you need us. If you'd like photography too, both together are £1,650, saving £200.

sections.heading: Natural, not staged
sections.text: We blend in and film the day as it happens: the nerves before the ceremony, the reactions of your friends and family that you didn't see at the time, and the raw, candid moments that disappear in the blur of the day. When it's the two of us, we can capture several angles at once, from the first look to the speeches.

sections.heading: Your film in 3–6 weeks
sections.text: Your wedding film is usually ready within 3 to 6 weeks of the wedding. We take half of the price upfront to secure your date, and the rest whenever suits you, up to two weeks after the wedding.

sections.heading: Where we film
sections.text: From our base in Belper we film weddings across Derbyshire, including Derby, Matlock, Ashbourne and the Peak District. We've worked at venues including Shottle Hall and West Mill in Darley Abbey, and travelled to London for a number of weddings.

faqs.question: How much does a wedding videographer cost in Derbyshire?
faqs.answer: Our wedding film is £1,100 for the whole day. Photography and film together is £1,650, saving £200. There are no hourly packages.

faqs.question: How long is the wedding film?
faqs.answer: Your wedding film is usually between 3 and 6 minutes long, edited to capture the story and feel of your day.

faqs.question: How long until we get our wedding film?
faqs.answer: Your wedding film is usually ready within 3 to 6 weeks of your wedding.

faqs.question: Do you film weddings outside Derbyshire?
faqs.answer: Yes. We're based in Belper, Derbyshire, and work across the UK. We've filmed weddings in London a number of times.
